name: StarsArena
_review_note: Decompiler limitation: ethervm returns "Error: Could not resolve method call return address" for key functions. Reentrancy confirmed via trace (0xb51d0534 called during AVAX transfer callback). But decompiled code is incomplete - cannot verify exact state update ordering from bytecode alone.
fix_description: In sellShares (func_2847), AVAX is sent to msg.sender via func_3139 (low-level call with value) BEFORE updating the share balance in storage. This enables reentrancy: the attacker receives AVAX, re-enters sellShares in the fallback, and sells the same shares again since the balance has not been decremented yet. Fix: update storage[shares_mapping] before sending AVAX (checks-effects-interactions pattern), or add a reentrancy guard.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short, direct reentrancy-style exploit with only a couple of external calls and a fallback reentry, fitting an obvious vulnerability pattern. It does not require complex DeFi primitives, flash loans, or deep protocol-specific setup to reproduce from the PoC.
